message:
feat(host): one local startup-only power policy for everything HostPowerKeepalive does; test hosts start with it OFF (test-injection-finding r4, Codex Finding-3 (1))

Codex codex_test_injection_finding.md Finding-3; verifier r4 (policy main 14cdde1).

- host_power_policy.hpp: --host-power-management on|off, the command line only, default ON (the product's behaviour
  unchanged). Bound in main BEFORE HostPowerKeepalive exists (its constructor's request included), immutable, no
  setter -- nothing remote can change it. Another value refuses the start (exit 65). The bound value is said in one
  line: "host power management=on|off (local startup policy, ...)".
- HostPowerKeepalive: explicit HostPowerKeepalive(bool) only (no default constructor). OFF: no execution-state
  request at construction, at a stream edge or at the end, and no display wake -- the streaming state is still
  tracked, nothing else changes. Its wake is private (no other caller); every effect goes through the OS boundary
  (os_input_effects.hpp; SetThreadExecutionState added: recorded, never performed, in the record-only build).
- e2e_injection_guard: the arguments are --input-injection-mode none --host-power-management off; the gate passes
  only when THIS launch said BOTH whole lines (injection OFF, power OFF); power on / no power line (an older build) /
  a refused argument -> not passed / INVALID, no client. The --prelogin launches (standby, punch, fatal) get the
  arguments too: their power object exists from the first line, client or not.
- older binaries (--old-host, REMOTE60_E2E_OLD_BIN): never started on this PC -- they would ignore the new argument;
  those cases are NOT RUN, unverified (Codex Finding-3 (4)).
- host_power_policy_record_test (record-only, pure): the binding (on/off/last/typo/missing/misspelt switch), OFF ->
  zero effects through construction / edges / repeats / end, ON -> the constructor's ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED, the edge's
  ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED + one wake (SendInput +1/-1, the broadcast), no second wake, the release -- all recorded, none
  performed; the gate's lines. 18/18. e2e_injection_guard_test 20/20 (5 new: power).

All seven host variants and 12 affected tests build; the product GNLinkStream.exe has no record-only marker
(gnlink_check_fixed_server self-test 52/52). Not run (the verifier: SOURCE first).
